rationale: The prompt materially requires complete genotype/subtype assignment and target-region CSV outputs. The anchored # HCV all-sequence non-COMET coverage audit scopes the source-visible material to Assign non-COMET HCV genotype and closest within-genotype subtype for every record in an all.fasta-style nucleotide FASTA, then report overlap with NS3 positions 36-175, NS5A positions 26-93, and NS5B positions 150-321; this is a meaningful neighbouring route, but it does not supply the stated requirement as an independently executable output.
